sources.author: Konstantin Pschera
files: dist/colors.js (npm ayu 9.0.0, the palette the ayu editor themes ship)
sources.note: Terminal colours follow ayu's terminal mapping onto syntax colours (red markup, green string, yellow func, blue entity, magenta constant, cyan regexp).

accent-hover.derived: accent with OKLab lightness moved 0.06 away from on-accent

accent-press.derived: accent with OKLab lightness moved 0.12 away from on-accent

scrim.derived: the darker of light.fg and dark.bg

success-text.derived: success (contrast solving adjusts it on each ground)

warning-text.derived: warning (contrast solving adjusts it on each ground)

info-text.derived: info (contrast solving adjusts it on each ground)

syntax.variable.source: editor.fg (ayu leaves variables in the text colour)

fill.sage.bg.derived: desert sage lightness 0.758 and chroma 0.034 x 1.55 (the theme's green against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of green

fill.sage.ink.derived: light.fg moved in OKLab lightness to 7.0:1 on fill.sage.bg (light.fg and light.bg reach 2.94:1)

fill.teal.bg.derived: desert teal lightness 0.853 and chroma 0.019 x 1.28 (the theme's cyan against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of cyan

fill.teal.ink.derived: light.fg moved in OKLab lightness to 7.0:1 on fill.teal.bg (light.fg and light.bg reach 4.04:1)

fill.forest.bg.derived: desert forest lightness 0.229 and chroma 0.009 x 1.55 (the theme's green against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of green

fill.forest.ink.derived: light.bg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.forest.bg

fill.terracotta.bg.derived: desert terracotta lightness 0.662 and chroma 0.143 x 1.24 (the theme's orange against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of orange

fill.terracotta.ink.derived: light.fg moved in OKLab lightness to 6.0:1 on fill.terracotta.bg (light.fg and light.bg reach 3.21:1)

fill.warm-grey.bg.derived: desert warm-grey lightness 0.776; the theme's neutral hue and chroma (at most 0.03)

fill.warm-grey.ink.derived: light.fg moved in OKLab lightness to 7.0:1 on fill.warm-grey.bg (light.fg and light.bg reach 3.09:1)

fill.clay-red.bg.derived: desert clay-red lightness 0.576 and chroma 0.200 x 0.92 (the theme's red against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of red

fill.cool-grey.ink.derived: light.fg moved in OKLab lightness to 7.0:1 on fill.cool-grey.bg (light.fg and light.bg reach 4.62:1)

fill.stone.bg.derived: desert stone lightness 0.753; the theme's neutral hue and chroma (at most 0.03)
